_note: First-encounter hints paged on the level introduction, once per profile. Triggers select actual layout encounters or this boss's routes/pickups; campaign feature ages put new concepts before older unseen encounters. Only visited pages are acknowledged on PLAY. {action} names the rebound key (PC) or gesture (touch).

hints.text: Switch lanes with {move_left} and {move_right}.
Gaps: jump with {jump}, or switch lanes.
Pink crackle means an electric fence. Jump it ({jump}) or change lanes.
This fence is open at the bottom: slide under it with {slide}.
Some fences switch on and off. Watch the flicker and listen for the crackle.
Keep moving past the outer lane to run along the wall. Signs block the wall and hurt.
Pink crackle on a wall: a wall fence. It switches on and off, so time your wall run past it, or jump off the wall ({jump}).
This wall fence covers only the bottom of the wall: jump ({jump}) before you step onto the wall to run above it.

Orange edges mark a break in a side wall: there's no wall to run on there, so a wall run drops you into the outer lane. Watch for them and step back onto the wall past the break ({move_left} / {move_right}).
This wall fence covers only the top of the wall: step onto the wall without jumping to run below it.
Step on the cyan pad to flip up onto the ceiling.
Green ramps launch you high onto the wall, with a burst of speed.
Speed pads give you a burst of speed.
Cyborgs fire in bursts: watch the arm glow, then switch lanes. Stomp their heads!
Cyborgs in windows guard the wall. Time your wall run to pass above or below.
Hover truck! Its sides are safe, its front is deadly. Stomp the red weak point on its roof.
Heli drone! Weave through the barrage, then hit a cyan pad to smash it into the ceiling.
Octodogs lunge in straight lines. Sidestep, jump, or bait them into a gap.
A rattling cover means a sewer screech. Leave its lane or jump it.
Weapons won't touch a generator. Stomp it or dash through it to knock out the fences around it.
A Barnacle Turret clings to the ceiling and shoots only at riders. When its cannon glows red, switch lanes, and don't run into it.
A Buzz Overdrive! When its saw revs and its lane lights red, leave that lane: it charges and cuts the floor away.

A building blocks the street: dash through it ({dash})! Without the dash you crash into it: that costs your armor or your shield, and kills you if you have neither. A run along a side wall passes it too.
Glitching cyborgs carry something worse, and killing one sets it loose. Your weapon fires at them too: switch it off in the shop to leave them be.
The Bad Dream slashes the lanes it lights red. Get out of them: another lane, a wall or a pad.
When the Resonator's halos line up and its fire roars and crashes, a red wave rolls along the floor. Jump it ({jump}), or be on a wall or the ceiling.

A statue with red eyes in a wall niche is a Gilded Sentinel. When its eyes flare and stone grinds, its halberd cuts what lights up red: the outer lane, and a band of its wall. Leave the lane, or run the wall above or below the band.

The Tithe Collector sucks up credits ahead of you. Touching it isn't deadly, but it grabs 25% of what you've collected. Catch it (stomp, shoot, or dash through it) for everything it took, plus a jackpot.

An Enforcer Truck is on your tail: its lights on the floor and the marker at the bottom show its lane, and it copies yours a moment late. Weapons can't hurt it. When your lane lights red ahead, change lanes before its lasers come. To wreck it, dodge an Octodog's lunge or a Buzz Overdrive's charge late: the charge hits the truck behind you.
A boss! Only its glowing red weak points and your weapons can hurt it.
It's pinned! Switch onto the fallen tower's slab anywhere along its low part, run up it and drop onto a red weak point.
It's pinned! Run along a lit wall (keep moving past the outer lane), then at the tall mark move back toward the lanes to jump onto a red weak point.
It's pinned! Step on a pad to ride the ceiling over it, then drop off the end onto a red weak point.
The Sleep Taker! Weapons can't touch it: only a fence generator's EMP can. When it shrieks, leave the lanes it lights red, or ride a pad up onto the ceiling: it can't reach you there.
A glowing generator! Run at it and the nightmare lunges in after you. When sparks leap from the generator into it, smash the generator: jump onto it, or dash into it.
A bridge ahead: its giant slash comes as you reach it. Step on the pad to ride the ceiling, out of its reach.
Purple mist marks where its hands will rise: row after row along the street, and on the walls too. Weave through the lane each row leaves open!
It's swallowing the light! Hazards and warnings still glow in the dark: keep reading them.
The House! Its reels say what's coming: cherries throw bombs, lightning rolls out a fence, BAR drops gold blocks. Then dodge by the warnings on the floor.
Glowing 7 buttons! Run over one to lock its reel on 7. Lock all three for the JACKPOT.
JACKPOT! Its hopper burst open: jump onto the glowing red hopper on its top to stomp it.
A 7 button on the wall! Run along the wall over it. Time the wall fences: they crackle before they switch on.
A 7 button on the ceiling! Take the anti-grav pad, ride under the billboard over it, and dodge the turrets' shots.
The Sewer Swarm! Its clusters surge down the lanes. The street is your weapon: lure them into live fences and holes.
A red line down your lane: a cluster is coming down it. Stand in a lane with a fence or a hole on the line, then get out of the way as it charges: it runs straight into it.
A wave of the swarm rising behind you! It crashes down on your lane and surges on along it: get out of the lane, and let it run into the fence or the hole ahead.
The Host crouches by a ramp, its implants glowing red! Take the ramp onto the wall, then wall-jump by the green chevrons to come down on them.
Hostile Takeover! You're on the Chairman's train: jump the gaps between its carriages and watch the security on its roofs.
A coupling glows red in the gap! Jump from the green chevrons in its lane to come down on it: the carriages behind break away.
The gunship is strafing! A red line and a rising whine mark the lanes its guns will rake: get out of them.
An armored carriage blocks the way! Step on an anti-grav pad to ride the gunship's belly over it, and jump from the green chevrons to come back up onto its red drop bay.
MERGER COMPLETE! The gunship has docked onto the locomotive: one war engine, with every attack of both.
Three docking clamps glow red under the war engine's belly! Take the anti-grav pads, ride its belly, and jump from the green chevrons in a clamp's lane to come back up onto it. Tear all three loose.
The Golden Convergence! Your weapons only scratch its golden suit. Everything it throws at you lights red before it lands: keep reading the floor.
Helidrones out of its cape! A red line and a rising whine mark each lane they'll rake: switch to a lane between the lines. A jump won't clear their fire.
A Flying Buttress! The next pass rakes a red line across every lane but its arch: move into its lane and run through the arch, or dash through the fire.
Its fist! It follows your lane, then locks a second before it falls: the red square shows where. Get out from under it, and jump the holes it leaves ahead.
A Flying Buttress where the fist will fall! Be in its lane when the fist locks, then switch away: the fist smashes it, and the tower it held up comes down beside the causeway as a wall.
Missiles! Every red mark on the floor will burn. Get onto the fallen tower's wall as the marks fill in (wall hop to stay up); with no wall, only armor, the shield and the dash get you through.

A Refill Ship feeds the suit its missiles! When it comes down over you, take the anti-grav pad under it: the pad hurls the helidrones up into the ship, and the blast races up its feed line into the suit.

The pad is caged by electric fences, and a jump over the front lands past it. Stomp ({jump}) or dash into the generator beside the cage to switch the fences off, or dash through a fence. Armor or a shield gets you through at the cost of a hit.

The Magnate hunts you from behind: the marker at the bottom of the screen shows his lane. When he roars and it turns red, he leaps over you and locks onto your lane: leave the lane his red square marks. A jump won't clear him.

A Flying Buttress rises as he pounces: be in its lane when he locks on and he crashes into its gate, stunned. Take off ({jump}) from the green chevrons to land on his back and stomp the red ports on his spine, or he shakes free.
He rears back a crackling cable on the balustrade: a red line marks where it will whip across every lane. Low, jump it ({jump}); high, slide under it ({slide}).
A snarl and his marker flashing red: he's right behind you, and red claw marks flash in your lane. Switch lanes at once ({move_left} or {move_right}): a jump won't clear his claws.
Screens crash down from the vault! Each red square marks where one lands: weave out of any square in your lane into a clear one. The screens that crash on The Magnate hurt him.
Armor pickup ahead: run through it to get your armor back at once. Armor blocks enemy attacks and electric shocks.
Shield pickup ahead: run through it. A shield blocks one hit of anything.
Grapple pickup ahead: run through it. The grapple hook saves you from one fall.

Beach volleyball! A ring on the sand shows where the ball comes down: switch lanes to get under it ({move_left} / {move_right}) and jump ({jump}) as the closing ring meets it to hit it back. Keep the rally going to win the point. Every point you win pays credits.
